    Class
    Description
    CallableSpec
    A stored-procedure or function call, described independently of any JDBC connection: the routine name, whether it returns a value, and its parameters in declaration order.
    CallableSpec.Direction
    How a parameter is passed: into the routine, out of it, or both.
    CallableSpec.Param
    One parameter of the call.
    CallResult
    What a stored-procedure or function call produced: the OUT/INOUT values keyed by parameter name (in declaration order), any result set the routine returned, the update count, how long it took, and the error message when it failed.
    ColumnAggregates
    Summary statistics for one column of a result grid, computed from the rendered cell text — the aggregate footer under the grid.
    DriverInfo
    Catalog entry for a JDBC driver: how to identify it, a sample connection URL, whether it ships bundled with the app, and (for on-demand drivers) its Maven coordinates so the driver manager can fetch it.
    JdbcConnectionPool
    Owns one HikariDataSource per connection profile and hands out pooled connections.
    JdbcPoolConfig
    Immutable tuning for a per-profile HikariCP connection pool.
